newsitem.title: INDIA: Militants kill nine in northeast India.
newsitem.headline: Militants kill nine in northeast India.

text.p: Tribal guerrillas in the northeastern Indian state of Manipur on Wednesday shot and killed at least nine people, eight of them paramilitary soldiers, army officials said.
The soldiers were escorting a bus when the militants fired at them near Saphermaina, 30 km (19 miles) from Imphal, the state capital.
Five soldiers were killed on the spot, officials said. Three soldiers and a bus passenger died in an Imphal hospital. About 15 passengers were wounded, six of them critically.
Dozens of militant groups in northeastern India are fighting for independent homelands.
